reviewMethod: Each selected stored file was independently byte-hash checked against the frozen GitHub evidence archive and visually inspected with its owning caption and paper theme. Task/page/article/source DOI binding, figure identity, capture protocol 6.2.20, fixed media generation, source role, image clarity and same-ID publication risk were checked. Capture success and review markers were treated as provenance evidence only, not semantic approval. No publisher recrawl, R2 write, direct import/repair, literature-data change or userscript change was performed.
